title: NFTStakerMigrator has no rescue function of any kind, no fallback and no receive
description: Its sibling InPlaceNFTStakerMigrator has both `rescueERC20` (:268) and a floor-guarded `rescueERC1155` (:281). Any ERC20 that lands in NFTStakerMigrator — the DEDUP-20-009 misroute, a donation, an airdrop, a fat-fingered transfer — is permanently unrecoverable.
impact: Any ERC20 that lands in NFTStakerMigrator — the CLASS-001 misroute, a donation, an airdrop, a fat-fingered transfer — is permanently unrecoverable. Its sibling InPlaceNFTStakerMigrator has both rescueERC20 (:268) and a floor-guarded rescueERC1155 (:281).
attackPath: 1. Not an attack. Value arrives at the contract by any means.
2. No rescueERC20, no rescueERC1155, no fallback, no receive.
3. Nobody, including the owner, can move it.
likelihood: n/a standing alone — it is a missing capability, not an event.
justification: Low. Standing alone this causes no loss — it is the ABSENCE of a recovery primitive, which is state-handling/hardening. Deliberately NOT escalated: escalating it would double-count CLASS-001, which is where the actual loss is filed. Its importance is that it is the factor CONVERTING CLASS-001 from a recoverable accounting misroute into permanent user-fund loss on the cross-staker path, and it is therefore the reason CLASS-001 is classified High rather than Medium.
recommendation: If CLASS-001 is fixed only at the depositFor call site, this remains the reason ANY future misroute to this contract is terminal. Adding a rescueERC20 here is cheap insurance independent of the call-site fix.

poc.note: Source read at 0d1a0b2: NFTStakerMigrator.sol is 112 lines with two non-constructor functions and no recovery primitive.
